mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates robust household demand that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases, or the rank IC between RSAFS and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate exceeds 4.0%, restrictive monetary policy compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 5-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in payroll employment signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5 and PAYEMS > 159000, or the rank IC between the interaction signal and returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing weakness reduces corporate capital expenditure and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5%, economic weakness reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the rank IC between UNRATE and 5-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and real consumer spending indicates strong household demand that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1300 and RSAFS > 730000, or the rank IC between the interaction signal and returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 325), the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 325, or the rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 20-day returns is below 0.03.
